11. SERVER-97911: `find({_id:{$in:[]}}).hint({_id:1})` traverses the **whole collection** in 8.0. 8.0 rewrites the empty `$in` to `$alwaysFalse`, and the hinted plan still scans. Jira records it as a regression from 7.0. It affects 8.0.1 and is fixed in **8.0.6** (resolved 2025-02-06). https://jira.mongodb.org/rest/api/2/issue/SERVER-97911 12. A sibling case, `{$elemMatch:{$in:[]}}`, also produced `$alwaysFalse` plus a full scan that hints could not avoid. SERVER-105375 fixed it in **8.0.11** (2025-05-23). Apps that build `$in` arrays dynamically and can send an empty array should run ≥8.0.11.
